verdicts.reason: A is basically the landscape layout scaled up and centred in the portrait canvas. Hierarchy and grouping are kept, but there is a lot of empty space above and below (the top ~22% and bottom ~20% are blank), so it doesn't really fit the portrait shape. B breaks the hierarchy: the headline is shrunk onto one small line, the CTA is tiny and sits on its own away from the copy, the kicker and fine print are illegibly small, and the elements are scattered across big dead zones.
